text:
Nina: Quick thread to pick final cuts for observability before roadmap freeze. Customers demand: route cost, error grouping, cold-start signal in traces. Need a one-slide proposal.

Omar: Engineer estimate: route cost = infra + UI ~2 sprints; error grouping = small service + fingerprinting ~1 sprint; cold-start tracing = runtime change + sampling ~2 sprints with perf testing.

Luis: Recommendation: MVP = per-route cost + aggregated error buckets + sampled traces with a cold_start boolean (sampling <=3%). Defer raw prompt samples and repro prompts to Dedicated pilots.

Nina: Launch criteria draft: per-route cost visible in Console, top-20 error buckets with counts, sampled traces with cold_start flag and <5% p50 overhead in canary. Rollout: 2% canary -> 20% -> 100% with kill-switch.

Omar: Implementation note: new topic obs.events.v2 with {req_id, route, model_id, tokens, error_sig, cold_start}. Daily rollups power UI charts. Sampling config: `trace.sample_pct=2.5`.

Luis: Risks: storage for traces and privacy for samples. Mitigations: 7-day retention for hosted, sanitized example ids only, opt-in deeper sampling for Dedicated.

clarity-bot: RFC created: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/obs-mini-mvp-1791 — please review.
